notes.title: Update 2.0: Create Your Own Personal Hell in the Enforcer Edition
notes.content:
[h3]Want to fully customize your holiday in Hell? 🔥

Now you can![/h3]

[previewyoutube=zlwf9sZGZxo;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/b5d959a3e2262df3706f6b358849b3506173786b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/d8b9e1fc7dfe63ef16af5fe918a451427a5cc426.gif[/img]

[h3]Alongside our current “Escape the Maze” mode, we’ve added two new gameplay modes for those of you who want a dash more (or a dash less) carnage in their infernal soup. [/h3]

[h3]Speedrun Mode[/h3]

For those of you who yearn to dash and tear your way through demons at a record pace, we’ve added a Speedrun Mode. Unleash your inner run-and-gunslinger and take on each of the Guardians in their own gauntlet. Challenge your friends or even the entire Scathe Discord community to speedrun competitions. Do you have what it takes to set a new record time?

[h3]Arcade Mode[/h3]

If you’re looking for a more zen experience as you battle your way through the legions of the damned, we’ve added an Arcade Mode, a stripped back version of Scathe where all you need to do is focus on killing as many enemies as possible to pump up your score. Keep your trigger finger itchy and your legs moving to snag that top score!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/b7b8c973f4f321eea992177c77bb0c4830265bd9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/7a645747e00cc7fb0788134baec2752eab14985a.gif[/img]

[h3]Scathe now features even more modifiers, so you can totally customize your experience:[/h3]

[b]Weapon of Choice[/b] - You can now start your game with every weapon and every spell available thanks to our All Weapons modifier. Cut out the search time and blast IN to your enemies with a full arsenal.

[b]Can’t Touch Me[/b] - Enjoy feeling untouchable with the Invincibility modifier. Now you can slice your way through demons without fear!

[b]Demonize with Demon Eyes[/b] - Tear through your enemies like paper with the Constant Demon Mode modifier. 

[b]Live Fast, Die Never[/b] - You can forget about checkpoints and collecting extra lives with the Infinite Lives modifier. Toggle this on and you’ll just respawn wherever you were when you died. 

[b]The More, the Murderier[/b] - Select the Demon Overload modifier and get ready for the challenge of your (probably quite short) life. Think of it as Scathe: Now With MORE Demons! 

[b]PandAMMOnium[/b] - Forget about ammo pickups and shoot to your heart’s content with the Infinite Ammo modifier. 

[h3]We’ve also made a few quality of life improvements, such as:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Dash killing demons will now provide a small health gain.
[*] The Hell Hammer will now vent off a little bit of steam after every clip to provide a break in firing (and give it a much needed break).
[*] Brand new firing audio for the Hell Hammer - bringing more boom to the room!
[*] Head bob now defaults to zero for a more retro feel.
[*] Landing a headshot will now provide you with some extra ammo as a well-earned reward.
[*] AI spawn rates and timeouts have been improved in barrier sections.
[*] Fleshies and other ball-type enemies now drop ammo on death.
[*] Collision has been removed on multiple props in zones for a smoother movement experience.
[*] A bridge has been added to Oxide’s zone to help prevent players from falling into lava.
[/list]

[h3]And squashed a few more bugs:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Swarm AI no longer stops moving if only one section of it remains.
[*] Huge improvements to AI spawning so they don’t spawn too close. This excludes arenas and barrier sections.
[*] Toned down the joypad vibration when fighting the enemy Sledge.
[*] Fixed multiple areas where AI could become stuck.
[*] Misaligned walls in three zones have been correctly aligned.
[*] Fixed bridges that would fail to descend correctly when all Demons were eliminated.
[*] Fixed the issue where the joypad prompt would remain static on the screen after losing your last life and disconnecting.
[*] Jitters should no longer submerge into the ground in a specific zone after spawning.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1154830/Scathe/

[h3]Thank you once again to all of the community members who submitted bug reports and we hope you enjoy the shiny new Enforcer Edition of Scathe 🤘 

Don’t forget to join our Discord and follow us on social media at @ScatheFPS to let us know what you think of the update![/h3]

[url=https://bit.ly/ScatheDiscord][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/a6ce8159378974a6fc9052b184b7088213852cbb.gif[/img][/url]


[url=https://bit.ly/ScatheFBPage][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/bb7e23a1085b28d25df050902e1e02b960917525.png[/img][/url][url=https://bit.ly/ScatheTwitter][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/53a9f2fcd1bf24f4e1735dbc90b248bd39572da1.png[/img][/url][url=https://bit.ly/ScatheInsta][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/1e551f92a20d174c14f449ebd6ef769c2f8de0af.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Update 1.0: Prepare to be blinded by the Guiding Light Update 💥
notes.content:
[h3]We’re excited to announce that our first free update has gone live 🔴[/h3]

Before we discuss what changes we’ve made, we’d like to thank everyone who took the time to provide feedback on Scathe via Steam reviews, our Steam forum, and our Discord. All of the quality of life changes we’ve made in this update were based on this community feedback, so we couldn’t have done it without you 🤘

Below, you’ll find our guide to all of the changes we’ve made to the game, along with a list of bugs that we’ve squashed along the way 🐛


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/e5de50c9c950189e919b12ef8d42edf70826f00f.png[/img]

[h3]Updated Maps[/h3]

Want to know what gore-splattered secrets and explosive weapons await you in the infernal labyrinth?

We’ve updated our map system so that zones containing Dark Magic spells, new weapons, and bosses will be signposted on the World Map using new icons 🌎

Zones you’ve already visited will contain information about how many runes you’ve collected, what weapon you picked up there, what spell you picked up there, and your overall percentage completion for that zone. 

We’ve also added a zone map, so you can see clearly where you are in each zone, how many possible exits there are, and how you’ll need to navigate through the zone if you want to reach one of them 🗺️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/f50f335e4068f8551f80995893d962cef91cb40d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/f01d22e755207bcee85bc8adc935e4fa26d46c94.gif[/img]

[h3]Fast Travel[/h3]

We want you to have the smoothest possible trip through Hell, so we’ve added fast travel to Scathe 🏃

This means you won’t have to backtrack through zones if you need to pick up runes, find spells, or simply enjoy a blood-splattered romp through a zone you particularly enjoy 🩸

All you need to do is click on a zone you’ve already visited and it will give you the option to fast travel there. If the zone has multiple entrances/exits, you’ll be placed at the entrance where you originally entered the zone, so you can replay your past glory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/ebbaa270ec54a3b614836f457f9b0130255af860.png[/img]

[h3]New Objectives System[/h3]

Every zone now comes with a banner that contains a list of objectives, which will help guide you on your journey through the fiery depths of the underworld 🔥

These objectives will encourage you to find a certain number of runes in each zone, point you in the direction of exits that lead to weapons/spells/bosses, and much more. As you accomplish each objective, it will be marked off of the checklist, for that extra sense of demonic achievement!

If you want a real challenge, there is also a speedrun time set for each zone, so get those running shoes on 💨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/8f3e4d020cf2cc704e800ce3d119c265283f6a5a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/4e985cc7036046428178ab5c3a128428befd146d.gif[/img]

[h3]Improved Tutorial System[/h3]

We’ve fleshed out our tutorial system to include more in-depth information on how to use new weapons, Dark Magic spells, and Demon Mode 🔮

Much like the Demon Compendium, you can access this information at any time in the main menu, so all of that demon-slaying knowledge is at your fingertips!

Prompts for the face wipe and dash will now no longer be in the sidebar like the tutorials, but will instead be a stronger prompt in the middle of the screen.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1154830/Scathe/

[h3]To finish, here are a few of the minor bugs that have also been fixed:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Voiceovers and subtitles going missing during gameplay;
[*] The host and client both being able to drop out of the world in a certain special door within Zone 34;
[*] The host and client being able to escape the world yet again through the Guardian Doors for Scourge and Chaos;
[*] The achievements “Such Sin” and “Scathe Too” not triggering properly when completed;
[*] Game occasionally crashing for one or multiple clients during co-op games after all lives were lost;
[*] Too many Scuttlers spawning during the fight with Scourge, causing FPS drops;
[*] Walls in Zone 28 appearing to be misaligned with the floor;
[*] A pillar in Zone 47 appearing to be misaligned with the environment.
[/list]

[h3]Got any more ideas or feedback you’d like to suggest for our future updates?[/h3]

Then don’t forget to join our forum and Discord server, where you can share them with us directly 💬

You can also follow us on social media at @ScatheFPS for awesome gameplay footage 🤘

notes.title: Quality of Life Changes and Demonic Bug Squashing: Notes for Patch #1 🐛

tags.balance_change: The health of all bosses has been reduced.
The health of all ball-type enemies (Fleshies, Swampies, Pinballs, Industriballs, and Invisiballs) has been reduced.

tags.feature: Demon squishy bits travel further and look better when performing a dash kill.

tags.balance_change: The number of ammo pick-ups in each zone has been increased and the amount of ammo each weapon can hold has been increased!

tags.feature: You will no longer encounter ammo pick-ups for weapons you haven’t discovered.
An updated model for the Reaper demon has been added.
The voiceover from the Divine Creator and Sacrilegious can now be enabled/disabled in the Audio Settings.
The total game time stat has now been added to the pause menu.
All filters will now be unlocked for new users.

tags.bug: The bug with the client’s weapon wheel during co-op games has been fixed, so your friends (and fellow enforcers) can rest easy knowing they can now switch between their weapons with impunity.
Clients were sometimes unable to use spells during co-op games.
The bug where the music would stop after various pick-ups or when the Demon Mode spell was used has been resolved, so you can rock out without fear of losing your demon-slaying groove.

tags.feature: Scathe now supports ultrawide resolution! We’ve added the new resolution to the menu settings.

tags.bug: The Health and Magic Bar would reset after transitioning to new or previous zones during co-op games.
Client’s ID would sometimes fail to update instantly after kicking a player out from a co-op game.
The Warlock mini-boss would sometimes get stuck too high up in the zone.

tags.balance_change: The excessive brightness of the lava has been toned down on low graphical settings.

tags.bug: The Raven (Magic Gun) would sometimes disappear after the player lost a life.
The incorrect number of lives being displayed for clients during co-op games;
The incorrect amount of ammo being displayed for clients during co-op games;
The Magic Bar failing to deplete for the client when using the Raven;
The hanging corpses in the environment showing metal impacts when shot instead of fleshy impacts;
The Magic Ring sometimes failing to appear for the client after they rejoined an ongoing co-op session;
The game reverting back to the Raven instead of the Magic Ring after transitioning between zones;
The Magic Bar continuing to deplete after casting the Freeze spell and while the spell was still active;
Sledge and Shock Sledge enemies disappearing completely after a player loses a life;
Razorback enemies becoming stuck after an arena had been cleared;
Overlapping text in the name and demon information box for the Grenadier Reaper enemy;
The inconsistency in the Ripper weapon pick-up animation if the player is holding the Raven;
Players sometimes taking damage after walking over the corpses of Winnowers during the mini-boss fight;
Demons being able to walk through a barrier in Zone 11;
The “Checking Privileges” pop-up lacking functionality with keyboard and controller;
The secret door in Zone 42 not closing properly after being triggered;
Shadow Demons have now been moved so they spawn in more appropriate locations/zones;
The Prism enemies now only spawn one at a time, since we discovered they lack collision with one another;
Extra spawns from Zone 7 have been removed;

tags.balance_change: The difficulty of Zone 24 has been scaled down to match other zones.

notes.title: 🔥🏹 Hone Your Razor-Sharp Aim 🏹🔥
notes.content:
[h3]Are you a sharp shooter looking for a precision weapon to slice up your enemies? 💀[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/733498604a7f8b5bb9fb17864684242d667d32c7.png[/img]

Then look no further!

The Bow Blade is a devilishly deadly combination of a crossbow and a disc launcher.

Its primary fire sends out a single powerful shot that can kill most demons in one hit while its secondary fire has been “cooked up” so that it bounces and explodes 3 times, meaning you can deal a scalding blow to up to three targets 🔥 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/e78cdc490eea0d6f1f1620f87ea4eb42d28f4e13.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/f2b21aa82a5bf8e4b57fca15aea777469482e138.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Damage:[/b] On Hit - Death
[b]Accuracy:[/b] Accurate
[b]Primary:[/b] Disc Launcher (Rate 0.5s)
[b]Secondary:[/b] Explosive Disc Launcher (Rate 10s)[/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/7aab3e1a938039aa52f6470cf48eaf444746528d.png[/img]

According to legend, each disc of the Bow Blade was handcrafted by the Divine Creator themself, as only they had the sacred power and knowledge required to forge a blade with an edge sharp enough to slice through the skin of demons. This is said to be the reason why ammo for the Bow Blade is so scarce and highly prized among enforcers. 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1154830/Scathe/

Don't forget to join our Discord server for exclusive gameplay content and follow us on social media at @ScatheFPS.

notes.title: 💥 Rip Your Foes Apart 💥
notes.content:
[h3]A trip to Hell would simply be incomplete without a meaty shotgun to sink your teeth into![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/29b300aa63bbfe6327f79495761e87085ecfcc33.png[/img]

The Ripper is a double barrel shotgun that packs a serious punch 💥

Use its primary fire to tear chunks out of sturdier foes or strategically place proximity mines using its secondary fire for crowd control when faced with the hordes of the damned. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/e78cdc490eea0d6f1f1620f87ea4eb42d28f4e13.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/40a19a19b33d3751ba17ba0193d302bd02c38a1e.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Damage:[/b] 48 per pellet (Ranging from 48 to 192 damage)
[b]Accuracy: [/b]Highly inaccurate (Short burst/Buckshot spread)
[b]Primary:[/b] Shotgun Burst Fire
[b]Secondary:[/b] Proximity Mine Launcher [/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/7aab3e1a938039aa52f6470cf48eaf444746528d.png[/img]

Only the strongest and holiest enforcers may lay their hands upon the Ripper. Brimming with runic energy, its exterior is so hot to the touch that it will scald the skin of the unworthy. For time immemorial, it has been used to weed out the weak and ensure that the sacred lineage of enforcers retains its power.

notes.title: 🔥 Scathe is Releasing on August 31st 2022 🔥
notes.content:
[h3]Something wicked this way comes…[/h3]

At the Future Games Show last weekend, we announced our official release date 😱

Get ready to blast out of bullet hell this autumn, because Scathe will be coming out on August 31st 2022 🔥

Not only that, but we revealed a brand new gameplay feature that is sure to leave you feeling spellbound!

Watch our release date trailer below to see our official release date reveal at the Future Games Show and read on to learn more about our new gameplay mechanic 👇

[previewyoutube=cn3yxYqL2n4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Scour the underworld for ancient relics and harness the dark magic of the Fallen Mages.[/h3]

As you battle your way through the infernal labyrinth of Scathe, you may come across the wisdom of the Fallen Mages, which will unlock potent spells you can use to decimate your demonic foes 😈

Heal yourself, summon aid, and wreak havoc on the legions of Hell. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/8824233e0d2d4d8933d24836e4f7637faad0c7d5.gif[/img]


Are you fired up to get your hands on an explosive arsenal of weapons, master dark magic, and make your divine ascension?

Let us know in the comments 💬

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1154830/Scathe/

Get a taste of the carnage by joining our Discord server, where you can request a code for our demo, and check out exclusive gameplay updates across our social media channels at @ScatheFPS.

notes.title: UPDATE 24!
notes.content:
[b]It's been a while, but here's the latest from SCATHE![/b]

If you didn't know already, we do updates about SCATHE in our Discord. 
This is from Update 24 (and bits of update 23)
If you want to see more - join our discord:
https://discord.gg/AFk2qX3

First up, a new enemy to tackle.
Behold the BUTCHER!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/9a012d3b95adbd863aafde6ff9a9d81faac480e2.jpg[/img]

Simply put - he's gross! On the weapons side - he's packing a heavy gun, similar to that of another enemy; Sledge.

From one enemy concept to another...
You maybe noticed the turrets in the game, here's a different style of one:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/d3ce02fa8ffbedea4fac44e22ea96919aea1e8b3.jpg[/img]

This is a laser turret that floats in the air (generally chained). 
It's part of a laser turret family, some spin, some float etc.
These should always be the priority went spotted. Lasers do serious damage.

Next up, a weapon!
You might remember the Thunderbolt from before?
Here's the first of it in game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/4f7d32dd92d48b19aa69ca37db2058ad4ccfd858.jpg[/img]

It's looking good, nice hefty size and soon to gain features.
Prepare for some serious lightning!

For those who have been keeping up with Scathe - here's the latest shot of OXIDE.
One of the guardians (bosses), and a rather nice close-up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/c9c8bc6ff8d9ef32983e6fcd09d925fcc43a8113.jpg[/img]

When you defeat a guardian, you gain a Hellstone - here is how the Hellstone looks in game now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/e2fef80eebbb576f74880bc0363746e745b24bc8.jpg[/img]

You collect four of these to unlock the exit (and escape!).
Collect runes to unlock boss doors, collect Hellstones to unlock the exit. Simple.

...and to finish this update, here is a screenshot from a zone, near the dead forest (close to the swamp) regions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35849481/884f855f72016ab70c728ed8e26462fe413451b4.jpg[/img]

Remember and join us on Discord if you want to see more: https://discord.gg/AFk2qX3

That's all from us for this update! ːsteamthumbsupː
